title: Calculus 1
description:
### Course description

This first-year course builds the mathematical foundations used throughout the DSBA programme. It covers single-variable and multivariable calculus, including limits, derivatives, integration, and elementary optimization.

### Topics

- Sequences, limits, and continuity
- Derivatives and integrals of single-variable functions
- Functions of several variables and partial derivatives
- Basic optimization problems

Source: [Official HSE DSBA course page](https://www.hse.ru/en/ba/data/courses/1163495896.html). Summary adapted from the published abstract and course contents.

title: Linear Algebra and Geometry
description:
### Course description

The course introduces students to the elements of linear algebra and analytic geometry, provides the foundations for understanding some of the main concepts of modern mathematics. There is a strong emphasis in this course on complete proofs of almost all results.

We will approach the subject from both a practical point of view (learning methods and acquiring computational skills relevant for problem solving) and a theoretical point of view (learning a more abstract and theoretical approach that focuses on achieving a deep understanding of the different abstract concepts).

Topics covered include: matrix algebra, systems of linear equations, permutations, determinants, complex numbers, fields, abstract vector spaces, bilinear and quadratic forms, Euclidean spaces, some elements of analytic geometry, linear operators. It took mathematicians at least two hundred years to comprehend these objects. We plan to accomplish this in one year.

Source: [Wiki FCS — LAaG DSBA 2026/2027](https://wiki.cs.hse.ru/LAaG_DSBA_2026/2027?oldid=97769), revision 97769; formatting adapted. title: Calculus 2
description:
### Course description

Calculus 2 develops advanced calculus through infinite sequences and series, functional series, infinite products, Euler integrals, and multiple integrals. It also explores how power series and generating functions can be used to solve problems in discrete mathematics. The course assumes familiarity with basic calculus, including limits, derivatives, and integrals.

### Topics

- Numerical and functional series, including convergence
- Infinite products and Euler integrals
- Multiple integrals
- Power series and generating functions

Source: [Official HSE DSBA course page](https://www.hse.ru/ba/data/courses/1163496071.html). Summary adapted from the published abstract. The original [FCS Wiki course page](https://wiki.cs.hse.ru/Calculus_2_DSBA_2026/2027?oldid=97707) contains the course materials.

title: Introduction to Finance
description:
### Course description

[Introduction to Finance 1 syllabus](https://www.hse.ru/edu/courses/1163485416)

[Introduction to Finance 2 syllabus](https://www.hse.ru/edu/courses/1163485428)

“Introduction to Finance” is a basic two-semester course for second-year undergraduate students. The course is taught in English. It is part of the University of London curriculum. The approach of the course is analytical and emphasizes the link between microeconomics and finance.

The first part of the course - “Introduction to Finance I” - covers the essentials of capital budgeting and securities valuation, as well as basic asset pricing theories.

title: Deep Learning
description:
### Course description

The course is dedicated to studying deep learning, which is the most rapidly developing field of machine learning. The course attendees will learn what kinds of machine learning tasks can be solved using neural networks and what types of neural networks are currently in use. The course has a clear practical focus, students will have to train neural networks on the various frameworks using the Python programming language. The course also covers tasks related to images and texts.

title: Optimization Methods
description:
### Course description

This course introduces mathematical optimization through data-driven modeling, theory, and numerical algorithms. Students study how to formulate optimization problems and choose methods to solve them, from gradient-based and Newton methods to convex and combinatorial optimization. Linear algebra and calculus are prerequisites.

### Topics

- Unconstrained and constrained optimization
- Optimality conditions and Lagrange multipliers
- First- and second-order numerical methods
- Convex, linear, and combinatorial optimization

Source: [Official HSE DSBA course page](https://www.hse.ru/ba/data/courses/1163520471.html). Summary adapted from the published abstract and course contents.

title: Asset Pricing and Financial Markets
sourcePageTitle: Asset Pricing and Financial Markets DSBA 2026/2027
description:
### Course description

This course is aimed at students who wish to understand how financial markets work and how securities are priced. Using present value techniques, it gives a theoretical treatment of bond and stock valuation including portfolio theory and a development of the Capital Asset Pricing Model. The concept of financial market efficiency is introduced, and evidence for efficiency evaluated. Finally, there is a presentation of derivative pricing using absence of arbitrage arguments. The course is based on lectures, seminars, team work and self-study. “Asset pricing and Financial markets” is a two-semester course.

title: Natural Language Processing
description:
### Course description

The course “Natural Language Processing” introduces fundamental and modern methods for processing and analyzing natural language at the intersection of machine learning, deep learning, and computational linguistics. The course covers classical NLP methods, neural approaches to text processing, language modeling, attention and Transformer-based architectures, and modern large language models (LLMs). Particular attention is given to practical applications of LLMs, including fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, efficient inference, evaluation, tool use and agents, as well as multimodal models and selected topics in reliable and responsible NLP.
